attributes.title: AMCP Nexus 2027
attributes.summary:
AMCP Nexus 2027 is scheduled for October 18 to 21, 2027, at the Marriott Orlando World Center in Orlando, Florida, according to AMCP's list of future meetings. Nexus is the Academy of Managed Care Pharmacy's fall meeting for pharmacists and other professionals working in health plans, PBMs and the pharmaceutical industry.

The 2026 edition advertised more than 30 CE-accredited sessions on formulary development, value-based care, biosimilars and real-world evidence. For 2027, the program, CE hours and registration fees have not been published yet; we will add them when AMCP opens the 2027 site.
